name: MTAC 416 422 (MTAC, 422 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".801 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".410 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .416, Grains 422, Minimum Required Twist *1-13", Part Number MTAC 416 422, G1 BC .801 (A.B.), G7 BC .410 (A.B.), OAL 1.976", Bullet Projection 1.357"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.357".
